## HL · Daily report (Boss 3 · D6)
At 20:00: today's confirmed orders and revenue, top three products, low stock, open summaries older than 2 hours, and how many messages were passed to Tolu today, as one Telegram message.

**Credentials:** Google Sheets OAuth2 in the four Sheets nodes; Telegram API in Report to Tolu.
**Placeholders:** YOUR_SHEET_ID (same workbook as the bot), YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.

The reads after Orders have **Execute Once** on, and all four have **Always Output Data**, so an empty sheet doesn't stop the report. Settings → Error workflow → HL · Error alerts.
